primary_legal_basis: 1899 and 1907 Hague Conventions; party agreements; treaty clauses
typical_parties: states, state entities, international organizations, private parties where agreed
dispute_types: state-to-state, investor-state, contract, boundary, maritime, environmental, mixed disputes
enforcement_pathway: party compliance, treaty mechanisms, domestic enforcement where applicable
notes: Administrative institution rather than a single standing court.

primary_legal_basis: UNCLOS Part XV and Annex VII
dispute_types: law of the sea disputes, maritime entitlements, marine environment, fisheries, navigation
enforcement_pathway: UNCLOS compliance obligations and diplomatic/legal pressure
notes: Default dispute-settlement procedure where parties have not chosen the same forum.

primary_legal_basis: ICSID Convention, investment treaties, contracts, investment laws
dispute_types: investment disputes, expropriation, fair and equitable treatment, discrimination, denial of justice
enforcement_pathway: ICSID Convention recognition and enforcement duties
notes: Designed for investor-state disputes; source of major legitimacy debates.

forum_type: ad hoc or administered procedural framework
primary_legal_basis: party agreement, investment treaties, contracts, UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules
enforcement_pathway: New York Convention or other applicable enforcement frameworks
notes: Rules are widely used even when an institution administers the case.

primary_legal_basis: arbitration agreement, institutional rules, national arbitration laws
dispute_types: contract, construction, energy, shipping, finance, sale of goods, technology
enforcement_pathway: New York Convention and domestic arbitration law
notes: Important to cross-border private dispute resolution but distinct from public international adjudication.
